import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Topology Filter Real Complex TopologicalSpace Finset Set
open scoped BigOperators

theorem variable_increment_tendsto
  {f : ℝ → ℝ} {a L : ℝ}
  (ha : 0 < a)
  (hfd : DifferentiableOn ℝ f (Set.Ioi 0))
  (hf : Tendsto (deriv f) Filter.atTop (𝓝 L)) :
  Tendsto (fun x => f (x + a) - f x) Filter.atTop (𝓝 (a * L)) := by
  have hMVT : ∀ x > 0, ∃ c, x < c ∧ c < x + a ∧ f (x + a) - f x = a * deriv f c := by
    intro x hx
    have hx_lt : x < x + a := lt_add_of_pos_right x ha
    have h_sub : Icc x (x + a) ⊆ Ioi 0 := by
      intro y hy
      exact lt_of_lt_of_le hx hy.1
    have hfc : ContinuousOn f (Icc x (x + a)) := (hfd.mono h_sub).continuousOn
    have hfd' : DifferentiableOn ℝ f (Ioo x (x + a)) :=
      hfd.mono (subset_trans Ioo_subset_Icc_self h_sub)
    rcases exists_deriv_eq_slope f hx_lt hfc hfd' with ⟨c, hc, hc_eq⟩
    refine ⟨c, hc.1, hc.2, ?_⟩
    have ha_sub : x + a - x = a := by ring
    rw [ha_sub] at hc_eq
    rw [hc_eq, mul_div_cancel₀ _ ha.ne']
  have h_choice : ∀ x, ∃ c, 0 < x → (x < c ∧ c < x + a ∧ f (x + a) - f x = a * deriv f c) := by
    intro x
    by_cases hx : 0 < x
    · obtain ⟨c, hc1, hc2, hc3⟩ := hMVT x hx
      exact ⟨c, fun _ => ⟨hc1, hc2, hc3⟩⟩
    · exact ⟨x, fun h => (hx h).elim⟩
  choose c hc using h_choice
  have h_ev : ∀ᶠ x in atTop, x ≤ c x :=
    (eventually_gt_atTop 0).mono (fun x hx => (hc x hx).1.le)
  have hc_tendsto : Tendsto c atTop atTop :=
    tendsto_atTop_mono' atTop h_ev tendsto_id
  have h_deriv : Tendsto (fun x => deriv f (c x)) atTop (𝓝 L) :=
    hf.comp hc_tendsto
  have h_mul : Tendsto (fun x => a * deriv f (c x)) atTop (𝓝 (a * L)) :=
    tendsto_const_nhds.mul h_deriv
  refine h_mul.congr' ?_
  exact (eventually_gt_atTop 0).mono (fun x hx => ((hc x hx).2.2).symm)

import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Topology Filter Real Complex TopologicalSpace Finset Set
open scoped BigOperators

theorem variable_increment_tendsto
  {f : ℝ → ℝ} {a L : ℝ}
  (ha : 0 < a)
  (hfd : DifferentiableOn ℝ f (Set.Ioi 0))
  (hf : Tendsto (deriv f) Filter.atTop (𝓝 L)) :
  Tendsto (fun x => f (x + a) - f x) Filter.atTop (𝓝 (a * L)) := by
  rw [Metric.tendsto_atTop] at hf ⊢
  intro ε hε
  have hεa : 0 < ε / a := div_pos hε ha
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := hf (ε / a) hεa
  use max N 1
  intro x hx
  have hxN : N ≤ x := le_of_max_le_left hx
  have hx0 : 0 < x := by linarith [show 1 ≤ x from le_of_max_le_right hx]
  have hsub : Icc x (x + a) ⊆ Ioi 0 := by
    intro y hy
    exact lt_of_lt_of_le hx0 hy.1
  have hcont : ContinuousOn f (Icc x (x + a)) := (hfd.mono hsub).continuousOn
  have hdiff : DifferentiableOn ℝ f (Ioo x (x + a)) :=
    hfd.mono (subset_trans Ioo_subset_Icc_self hsub)
  have hlt : x < x + a := lt_add_of_pos_right x ha
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hderiv⟩ := exists_deriv_eq_slope f hlt hcont hdiff
  have hcN : N ≤ c := le_trans hxN (le_of_lt hc.1)
  have hc_bound := hN c hcN
  rw [Real.dist_eq] at hc_bound ⊢
  have h_sub : x + a - x = a := by ring
  rw [h_sub] at hderiv
  have h_eq : f (x + a) - f x = a * deriv f c := by
    rw [hderiv, mul_div_cancel₀ _ ha.ne']
  rw [h_eq]
  have h_alg : a * deriv f c - a * L = a * (deriv f c - L) := by ring
  rw [h_alg, abs_mul, abs_of_pos ha]
  have h_mul := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hc_bound ha
  rw [mul_div_cancel₀ ε ha.ne'] at h_mul
  exact h_mul
